description: The historical RQ2 geometry capture: per-case residual-stream activations for the safe target (E), the historical d1 donor (B_d1) and the harmful contrast (H), at the final prompt token, for historical decoder blocks 31/32/33. It is the source of the validated dual-direction bank and of the frozen RQ2 comparator direction, and it is the only activation input that bank reads.
role: frozen input; read-only, never rebuilt, never regenerated

origin.access: read-only historical evidence; never modified, renamed or written into

local_destination.note: the absolute path of the data root is machine-local and appears only in configs/paths.local.json, which is gitignored. The destination above is relative to that root.

verification_rule: Every file is re-hashed before use. The recorded SHA256 is the gate: a file whose digest differs is refused, and no run proceeds. Copying a file to the local data root does not change its digest; a copy whose digest differs from its source is a failed copy, not a new input.

capture.pt.role: the activation tensors and their metadata
capture.pt.read_with: torch.load(map_location='cpu', weights_only=True); no pickle in this file is executed

manifest.json.role: the capture's own provenance record: model, dtype, layers, slot convention and the per-case prompt digests

digests_agree_with.record: the RQ2 final method freeze's own input-hash manifest
digests_agree_with.note: the freeze recorded these two digests when it consumed the capture on 2026-07-21. They are reproduced here so this manifest is independently checkable, not so it becomes a second source of truth.

tensors_read_by_the_direction_bank.dtype_note: the forward pass ran in bfloat16; the capture stores float32 casts of those activations, not float32-precision activations
tensors_read_by_the_direction_bank.not_read_note: the bank recomputes its deltas from the three arm tensors. The capture's own derived deltas are left unread so the recipe in routegate.directionbank is the only construction in play.

geometry.numbering_rule: the historical index is a zero-based decoder block; this package numbers stored representations with the embedding output as state 0, so state = block + 1
geometry.token_position_note: window=1, slot 0: the final prefill row, the position that decides generated token 1. Decode positions are not read.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
model.revision_provenance: the capture's own manifest.json records the model name but no revision. The revision above is the one pinned by manifests/rq2_actuator.json, configs/causal_repair.json and configs/orthogonalized_population_scan.json for the same model and the same historical workspace. It is asserted from those records, not stamped in the capture, and is recorded here as a provenance limitation rather than closed over.

eligibility_gate.role: the authoritative eligibility record. Which cases enter which direction is read from it and from nothing else.

case_digest_cross_check.note: the thirty prompt digests are checked three ways -- inclusion manifest, capture manifest, this file -- before any activation is read. All three agreed when this manifest was recorded.

parity_reference.claim: the repair direction rebuilt from this capture must reproduce that frozen comparator to float32 rounding. Both are B_d1 - E over the same ten cases by the same recipe, so a disagreement means the rebuild is a different construction.

explicitly_not_an_input: any held-out or sealed evaluation material
the 480-row RQ3 corpus extraction, which is a different population and carries none of these thirty prompts
the historical B_d2/B_d3 primary actuator, which is a comparison baseline and is validated for 3 of 10 cases
